case_number: 2025 INSC 415; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO………………… OF 2025 [ARISING OUT OF SLP (Crl.) NO. 205 OF 2025]
summary: Interpretation of CrPC s.256; dismissal for default vs. order of acquittal; COVID SOP barred dismissal without finding deliberate avoidance; High Court overreach in quashing revisional order; Sessions Judge within jurisdiction to reconsider; impugned order set aside; justice failure due to narrow interpretation; proceedings restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order dated 15th July, 2024 set aside; revisional order dated 19th November, 2022 restored; complaint case revived.
